description: This file defines the Bestseller class, which extends the Product model to retrieve a list of best-selling products from the database. It includes functionality for caching query results and constructing SQL statements specific to bestsellers.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: Extends the Product model to fetch and cache best-selling product data based on sales totals.

methods.name: getBestSellers
methods.description: Retrieves an array of best-selling products limited by the specified number, with caching to optimize repeated queries.
